detail.longDescription: 🤖 Rackspace Spot breach: leaked credentials (Nov 17, ~00:20–22:00 UTC) let attackers act as legit users in customer orgs — created pods, read Kubernetes Secrets, listed nodes/volumes. Tokens revoked; customers must rotate Secrets, API and refresh tokens. 🔗 https://www. bleepingcomputer.com/news/secu rity/rackspace-spot-breach-let-hackers-access-customer-kubernetes-secrets/ # DataBreach # Kubernetes # CloudSecurity
